text:
margaret: FYI 1: Variety reporter wants a 1-sentence methods line + 1-sentence quote on our benchmark post. Deadline ~40m. Who can own?
press_ops: I got this. Do we have a short methods blurb?
dave_eng: Shareable methods: 'Runs on Dedicated (NVIDIA A100 series), P99 on 1k tokenized requests; baseline runs disabled KV-prefix cache; q4f16 quantization used.'
claire_legal: That methods blurb is fine. For the quote, avoid comparative numbers.
margaret: Draft quote: 'We publish these benchmarks to make production tradeoffs between latency and cost visible to engineering teams.'
sophie_social: Social-ready: 'New: production benchmarks from Redwood  see how serving choices affect latency & cost. short.redwood/bench'
press-bot: Media alert: Variety draft detected 1 https://variety.example/redwood-bench-draft
press_ops: Sending methods + quote, requesting 40m hold. Will update tracker.
margaret: Thanks. Action: we'll create a 1-page "fast-quote" flow for legal signoff after this. :memo:
